digest.component_or_area: Binding recovery and retirement lifecycle management
propositions: A crash after retired tombstone replacement but before live replacement leaves the same identity in both live and retired state, detectable but not safely repairable at construction or preview time.

Pre-observation recovery must complete interrupted retirements only when tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry identities agree exactly, treating the durable tombstone as the committed side of the retired-first protocol.

The recovery invocation must occur after the under-lock staleness validation but before any write-bearing artifact is created or remote issue state is fetched, located in reconcile.py not run_differs.py.
Automatic 200, clear_absent, or same-key bind_confirm does not override a durable tombstone; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone and prevents completion.
Production code must not mutate bindings through all_bindings(), and apply_handlers.py must use the narrow rich-emission facade operation instead of direct mutation.
Repeat completion is a no-op; any tombstone/forward/reverse mismatch, corrupt live file, or replace failure retains recoverable evidence and safety-aborts without unrelated mutation.
